description: A residential driveway approach photographed at dusk with a deep blue-gray sky. A smooth asphalt or tarmac driveway runs from the foreground toward a low single-story house in the background. The house facade is light beige or cream limestone or natural stone veneer under a warm clay tile hip roof. A double-pane window glows with warm interior amber light, and a doorway on the left also radiates warmth. A narrow cobblestone or sett-paved edge strip borders the driveway, transitioning to a planted garden border of low groundcover, dark mulch, white flowering plants, and clipped shrubs at the lawn edge. The left side features multi-stemmed deciduous trees with fresh spring or summer foliage illuminated from below in warm amber uplight, creating dramatic green canopy contrast against the dark sky. Three slim dark charcoal bollard elements stand at intervals along the driveway edge, each angled slightly and directing a focused warm amber beam downward onto the cobblestone edging and garden bed, creating precise pools of light. The house wall beyond is washed in warm amber grazing light from a low source. The scene has a controlled, landscape-design quality with layered warm lighting pools against the deep blue twilight sky. Camera at standing eye-level, three-quarter perspective looking down the driveway length toward the house, normal focal length with moderate depth. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
